replies.author: NolanDalton
replies.body:
Michael's right, the entire PvP community is dying, look at OCN, they've been beating us in player count for a while, and even they are seeing a sharp player decrease, sure Avicus has stuff that needs to be fixed, but we count go around blaming the staff.

Back in late 2013 - early 2014, the player counts were usually 300 on the week days and 600-1000 on the weekends, and this was when half of the staff team was dead inactive, and couldn't be demoted due to broken commands (until Avicore came).

My point is that we can't blame the staff for all of the servers problems, yeah there are plenty of bad apples in the staff, but they aren't responsible in the sharp player count decrease.

replies.body:
https://avicus.net/rules

  1. The communication features provided through our Minecraft server, the forums and the Avicus Teamspeak server is a privilage.     • Spamming chat: repeatedly sending similar or identical messages to the point in which it may be bothersome and annoying to other users.
    • Linking to material that may be considered objectionable.
    • Linking to content that promotes other Minecraft services. This includes, but is not limited to, other Minecraft servers and their corresponding websites and social media content that promotes other Minecraft servers.
    • Using miscellaneous communication methods such as poking on the Teamspeak server in a repetitive and bothersome fashion.
